basic_details.job_title: NID Assam Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Design Instructor, Technical Instructor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Design, Assam (NID Assam) Recruitment Notification 2026 has been released on 15 October 2026 on the official website, nidj.ac.in. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the NID Assam Associate Senior Design Instructor, Design Instructor and Technical Instructor Recruitment 2026.

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid online through the Samarth portal payment gateway.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for all posts is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation and reservation benefits will be given to SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwD / Ex-Servicemen candidate(s) / Government Employee as per existing Central Government rules.

qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree in the relevant discipline/subject from a recognized institution.

important_instructions: Visit the Institute’s Careers Page at nidj.ac.in/careers or access the direct portal link at nidjnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login. Register as a new user by providing a valid email ID and mobile number, or log in with existing credentials. Fill out the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, and work experience. Upload self-attested scanned copies of all required supporting documents. Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway if applicable. Review all entered details and submit the application form. Download and save a copy of the completed application form for future reference. Candidates must satisfy themselves regarding minimum qualifications before applying. Separate applications must be submitted for each post if applying for more than one. All qualifications must be awarded by a UGC-recognized University or Institute, and only post-qualification experience is counted. Government and PSU employees must route their applications through proper channel or upload an NOC during online application and submit the original during the selection test. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification. All correspondence from the Institute will be made exclusively via email provided in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 4 vacancies for Group-B Non-Teaching (Technical) posts. The post-wise and category-wise distribution is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and experience requirements for each post as outlined below: Post Graduate Degree in the relevant discipline/subject from a recognized institution. The maximum age limit for all posts is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation and reservation benefits will be given to SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwD / Ex-Servicemen candidate(s) / Government Employee as per existing Central Government rules.

rows.essential_qualifications_experience: A Degree in the relevant discipline/subject from a recognized institution with 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field OR Diploma holder in the relevant field with 6 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

rows.post_name: Design Instructor (Communication Design, Textile & Apparel Design)
rows.essential_qualifications_experience: 3 years Diploma in relevant discipline/area/subject from a recognized institution with 4 years post-qualification experience in the relevant industry/educational institution OR A Degree in relevant area/subject from a recognized Institution with 2 years post-qualification experience in the relevant industry/institution.

3 years Diploma in relevant area/subject from a recognised institution with 4 years post-qualification in the relevant industry/educational institution OR A Degree in relevant area/subject from a recognised Institution with 2 years post-qualification experience in the relevant industry/institution.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointments will be made on a long-term basis at appropriate pay scales as per the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix. The Institute reserves the right to offer appointments initially on contract, which may be regularized based on performance and institutional requirements.

content_sections.heading: NID Assam Associate Senior Design Instructor Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be expected to handle academic and technical support, studio and laboratory coordination, equipment handling, and maintenance of tools and machinery. Specific duties include assisting faculty and students during practical classes and workshops, maintaining equipment logbooks, managing inventories, supporting institutional events and exhibitions, and contributing to technical infrastructure upkeep.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online through the Samarth portal payment gateway.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process may include a written test followed by a trade test of proportionate weightage, or other screening methods as determined by the Institute. Candidates shortlisted based on essential and desirable qualifications will be called for the selection process. No TA/DA will be paid for attending written tests or trade tests, but second AC train fare reimbursement will be provided to shortlisted candidates attending personal interviews from their current workplace or hometown.

content_sections.heading: NID Assam Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Visit the Institute’s Careers Page at nidj.ac.in/careers or access the direct portal link at nidjnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login . Register as a new user by providing a valid email ID and mobile number, or log in with existing credentials. Fill out the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, and work experience. Upload self-attested scanned copies of all required supporting documents. Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway if applicable. Review all entered details and submit the application form. Download and save a copy of the completed application form for future reference. Candidates must satisfy themselves regarding minimum qualifications before applying. Separate applications must be submitted for each post if applying for more than one. All qualifications must be awarded by a UGC-recognized University or Institute, and only post-qualification experience is counted. Government and PSU employees must route their applications through proper channel or upload an NOC during online application and submit the original during the selection test. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification. All correspondence from the Institute will be made exclusively via email provided in the application form.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for Group-B technical positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for PwD candidates?
faq.answer: No, PwD (Divyang) candidates are fully exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What mode of application is accepted by NID Assam?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly online through the Samarth portal linked on the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Are initial appointments made on a permanent or contract basis?
faq.answer: The Institute reserves the right to offer appointments initially on contract, which may be regularized based on performance and institute requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Where can candidates apply online for NID Assam recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official portal at nidjnt.samarth.edu.in.
